rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an emotional state or a good or bad mood.

example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 sam1 cing4 hou2 faan1 laa3

rows.note: Use this construction when someone is or is not disposed to do an activity.

example.english: I’m in the mood to go shopping today.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jau5 sam1 cing4 heoi3 haang4 gaai1

rows.note: Use this for the prevailing atmosphere or feeling among a group of people.

example.english: The mood was lively when the whole group had dinner together.
example.traditional: 成班人一齊食飯，氣氛好熱鬧。
example.jyutping: sing4 baan1 jan4 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6 hei3 fan1 hou2 jit6 naau6
